# eslint-plugin-node-security

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint Node security rules for Node.js — detects command injection, path traversal, SSRF, zip slip, and weak crypto (MD5/SHA-1, ECB, static IV) in fs, child_process, vm, and crypto.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-node-security
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import nodeSecurity from 'eslint-plugin-node-security';

export default [nodeSecurity.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `node-security/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

Use it alongside `eslint-plugin-security`, not instead of it: keep that plugin if the project has it. Measured overlap and the limits of both: https://eslint.interlace.tools/docs/getting-started/with-eslint-plugin-security

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `recommended` | 31    | 25     | 6        |
| `strict`      | 45    | 45     | 0        |

### `recommended`

31 rules:

- `detect-child-process` (error): Detects child_process usage that may allow command injection.
- `detect-eval-with-expression` (error): Detects strings turned into running code: eval(variable), the Function constructor, and vm / vm2 sinks mistaken for sandboxes.
- `detect-non-literal-fs-filename` (warn): Detects a variable in an fs call's filename, which may let an attacker reach any file.
- `no-unsafe-dynamic-require` (error): Prevent unsafe dynamic require() calls that could enable code injection.
- `no-buffer-overread` (warn): Detects buffer access beyond bounds.
- `no-deprecated-buffer` (error): Disallow the deprecated `new Buffer()` constructor and `Buffer()` factory call.
- `no-unsafe-buffer-alloc` (warn): Disallow `Buffer.allocUnsafe()` and `Buffer.allocUnsafeSlow()`, which return uninitialized memory.
- `no-toctou-vulnerability` (error): Detects Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use vulnerabilities.
- `no-zip-slip` (error): Detects zip slip/archive extraction vulnerabilities.
- `no-arbitrary-file-access` (error): Prevent file access from user input.
- `no-data-in-temp-storage` (error): Prevent sensitive data in temp directories.
- `no-ssrf` (warn): Flags HTTP calls whose URL is read off a request object (a user-input-named identifier only with reportUnresolvedUrls): a heuristic.
- `no-shell-injection` (error): Disallow concatenated or templated shell command arguments (CWE-78).
- `no-dynamic-command-string` (error): Disallow dynamically built command strings passed to a shell flag or a non-escaping command-runner (CWE-77).
- `no-env-injection` (error): Disallow writing process.env under a caller-controlled key, which can overwrite PATH, NODE_OPTIONS or LD_PRELOAD (CWE-99).
- `no-dynamic-algorithm-selection` (error): Disallow dynamic algorithm names in Node.js crypto functions (CWE-327).
- `no-timing-unsafe-compare` (warn): Disallow timing-unsafe comparison of secrets.
- `detect-suspicious-dependencies` (warn): Detect typosquatting in package names.
- `require-dependency-integrity` (error): Require SRI (Subresource Integrity) for CDN resources.
- `no-weak-hash-algorithm` (error): Disallow weak hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1, MD4).
- `no-weak-cipher-algorithm` (error): Disallow weak cipher algorithms (DES, 3DES, RC4, Blowfish).
- `no-weak-dh-parameters` (error): Disallow Diffie-Hellman and ECDH parameters below a safe strength.
- `no-static-iv` (error): Disallow static or hardcoded initialization vectors (IVs).
- `no-ecb-mode` (error): Disallow ECB encryption mode (use GCM or CBC instead).
- `no-math-random-crypto` (error): Disallow Math.random() for cryptographic purposes.
- `no-cryptojs` (error): Disallow deprecated crypto-js library (use native crypto instead).
- `no-self-signed-certs` (error): Disallow rejectUnauthorized: false in TLS options.
- `require-aead-tag-verification` (error): Require AEAD decryption to verify the authentication tag (setAuthTag + final).
- `no-unbounded-decompression` (error): Require a maxOutputLength ceiling on zlib one-shot decompression.
- `no-insecure-http-parser` (error): Disallow insecureHTTPParser: true on Node HTTP servers and clients.
- `require-stream-error-handler` (error): Require an 'error' listener on streams passed to .pipe(), which does not forward errors.

### `strict`

Everything in `recommended` plus 14 more (some shared rules run at a different severity here):

- `lock-file` (error): Ensure package lock file exists for the configured package manager.
- `no-dynamic-dependency-loading` (error): Prevent runtime dependency injection with dynamic paths.
- `require-secure-credential-storage` (error): Enforce secure storage patterns for credentials.
- `require-secure-deletion` (error): Require secure data deletion patterns.
- `require-storage-encryption` (error): Require encryption for persistent storage.
- `no-dynamic-require` (error): Forbid `require()` calls with expressions.
- `no-cryptojs-weak-random` (error): Disallow crypto-js WordArray.random() (CVE-2020-36732).
- `no-deprecated-cipher-method` (error): Disallow deprecated crypto.createCipher/createDecipher (use createCipheriv/createDecipheriv).
- `no-insecure-key-derivation` (error): Disallow PBKDF2 with insufficient iterations (< 100,000).
- `no-insecure-rsa-padding` (error): Disallow RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 padding (CVE-2023-46809 Marvin Attack).
- `no-modulo-biased-random` (error): Disallow reducing a random byte with % when the divisor does not divide its range.
- `no-sha1-hash` (error): Disallow sha1() from crypto-hash package (use sha256 or sha512).
- `prefer-native-crypto` (error): Prefer native crypto over third-party libraries.
- `require-emitter-error-handler` (error): Require an 'error' listener on http(s) requests and spawned processes.

## Other Interlace plugins by dependency

If the project also depends on one of these, add the matching plugin the same way:

- `express`: `eslint-plugin-express-security`
- `@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs/core`: `eslint-plugin-nestjs-security`
- `react`, `react-dom`, `preact`, `vue`, `svelte`, `@angular/core`, `solid-js`, `lit`, `next`, `nuxt`: `eslint-plugin-browser-security`
- `jsonwebtoken`, `jose`, `express-jwt`, `@nestjs/jwt`, `jwks-rsa`, `jwt-decode`: `eslint-plugin-jwt-security`
- `pg`, `pg-pool`, `pg-promise`, `postgres`, `slonik`: `eslint-plugin-postgresql-security`
- `mysql2`, `mysql`: `eslint-plugin-mysql-security`
- `mongodb`, `mongoose`: `eslint-plugin-mongodb-security`
- `better-sqlite3`, `sqlite3`: `eslint-plugin-sqlite-security`
- `knex`: `eslint-plugin-knex-security`
- `@prisma/client`, `prisma`: `eslint-plugin-prisma-security`
- `drizzle-orm`: `eslint-plugin-drizzle-security`
- `sequelize`: `eslint-plugin-sequelize-security`
- `typeorm`: `eslint-plugin-typeorm-security`
- `@supabase/supabase-js`: `eslint-plugin-supabase-security`
- `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-mcp-sdk-security`
- `openai`, `@openai/agents`: `eslint-plugin-openai-security`
- `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`: `eslint-plugin-anthropic-security`
- `@google/genai`: `eslint-plugin-gemini-security`
- `ai`: `eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security`
- `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`: `eslint-plugin-lambda-security`

The full stack-to-plugin playbook (with config rendering and a proof step) is the `security-linting` skill: https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/skills/security-linting
